metadata.description: Create a new contract in your HubSpot account using the CommerceContractsPublicApiService.
metadata.learn_more: Create a new contract in your HubSpot account using the CommerceContractsPublicApiService. This endpoint allows you to specify various contract details such as billing information, line items, and payment methods. The contract's effective date, currency, and other required fields must be provided in the request body. Successful creation returns the URL of the newly created resource.

addressTypesToCollect.label: Address Types To Collect
addressTypesToCollect.description: An array specifying the types of addresses to collect, with possible values including 'BILLING_ADDRESS' and 'SHIPPING_ADDRESS'.

allowedPaymentMethods.label: Allowed Payment Methods
allowedPaymentMethods.description: An array specifying the allowed payment methods, with possible values including 'CREDIT_OR_DEBIT_CARD', 'ACH', 'SEPA', 'BACS', and 'PADS'.

automatedTaxesEnabled.label: Automated Taxes Enabled
automatedTaxesEnabled.description: An object indicating whether automated taxes are enabled for the contract.

billingAddress.label: Billing Address
billingAddress.description: An object representing the billing address for the contract.

billingCompanyId.label: Billing Company Id
billingCompanyId.description: An object representing the ID of the billing company.

billingContactId.label: Billing Contact Id
billingContactId.description: A string representing the ID of the billing contact.

billingStartDateOverride.label: Billing Start Date Override
billingStartDateOverride.description: An object representing an override for the billing start date.

collectionProcess.label: Collection Process
collectionProcess.description: A string indicating the collection process for payments, with possible values including 'MANUAL_PAYMENTS' and 'AUTOMATIC_PAYMENTS'.

contractEffectiveDate.label: Contract Effective Date
contractEffectiveDate.description: A string representing the effective date of the contract, in date format.

currencyCode.label: Currency Code
currencyCode.description: A string representing the currency code for the contract.

customProperties.label: Custom Properties
customProperties.description: An object containing custom properties for the contract, with each property being a key-value pair.

dealId.label: Deal Id
dealId.description: An object representing the ID of the associated deal.

externalPaymentMethodReferenceId.label: External Payment Method Reference Id
externalPaymentMethodReferenceId.description: An object representing an external reference ID for the payment method.

hubspotBillingEnabled.label: Hubspot Billing Enabled
hubspotBillingEnabled.description: A boolean indicating whether HubSpot billing is enabled for the contract.

lineItems.label: Line Items
lineItems.description: An array of line items included in the contract, which can be custom, from a product, or cloned.

locale.label: Locale
locale.description: An object representing the locale settings for the contract.

name.label: Name
name.description: A string representing the name of the contract.

netPaymentTerms.label: Net Payment Terms
netPaymentTerms.description: An object representing the net payment terms for the contract.

ownerId.label: Owner Id
ownerId.description: An object representing the ID of the contract owner.

paymentEnabled.label: Payment Enabled
paymentEnabled.description: A boolean indicating whether payment is enabled for the contract.

poNumber.label: Po Number
poNumber.description: An object representing the purchase order number associated with the contract.

sellerCompanyAddress.label: Seller Company Address
sellerCompanyAddress.description: An object representing the address of the seller's company.

sellerCompanyDomain.label: Seller Company Domain
sellerCompanyDomain.description: An object representing the domain of the seller's company.

sellerCompanyName.label: Seller Company Name
sellerCompanyName.description: An object representing the name of the seller's company.

sellerEmail.label: Seller Email
sellerEmail.description: An object representing the email address of the seller.

sellerFirstName.label: Seller First Name
sellerFirstName.description: An object representing the first name of the seller.

sellerLastName.label: Seller Last Name
sellerLastName.description: An object representing the last name of the seller.

sellerPhone.label: Seller Phone
sellerPhone.description: An object representing the phone number of the seller.
